title.en: SAMPLE: A university says AI drafted a Bible translation
title.zh: SAMPLE：大學表示 AI 擬出了聖經翻譯的初稿

found.en: Quillon University says its language lab used an AI model to draft a Bible translation in a language with 60,000 speakers.
found.zh: Quillon University 表示，它的語言實驗室用 AI 模型起草了一部聖經翻譯，譯成一種有 6 萬人使用的語言。

matters.en: Many languages still have no full Bible. A draft that native speakers review could reach readers sooner.
matters.zh: 許多語言仍然沒有完整的聖經。由母語人士審閱的草稿，可能更早送到讀者手中。

ai_helped.en: Quillon University built the Quill Translator, which wrote the draft. Native speakers will review each verse before the translation is shared.
ai_helped.zh: Quillon University 開發了 Quill Translator，由它寫出草稿。在翻譯分享出去之前，母語人士會審閱每一節經文。

how_sure.en: Claimed. Quillon University says so in its own statement, and the lab has not published a paper. The university built the system.
how_sure.zh: 宣稱。Quillon University 在自己的聲明中這麼表示，這間實驗室還沒有發表論文。這套系統是這所大學開發的。

background.en: Translators have long worked by hand, one verse at a time.
background.zh: 譯者長期以來都是靠人工，一次翻一節經文。

could_lead.en: If reviewers find the drafts sound, the method could help smaller language groups.
could_lead.zh: 如果審閱者認為這些草稿可靠，這個方法可能幫助較小的語言群體。

evidence.quote: used an AI model, the Quill Translator, to draft a Bible translation

sources.title: SAMPLE: Quillon lab says its AI drafted a Bible translation
